entries.title: Thank HN: 7 months ago, I asked for help. Now I've got 5 employees.
entries.author: needmoney
entries.current_title: Thank HN: 7 months ago, I asked for help. Now I've got 5 employees.
entries.excerpt: 7 months ago, I posted asking the community how I could most efficiently make 300-400 US dollars a month, my cost of living, online (http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=1171520). You guys really poured out good ideas and several of you offered me work. Patio11 was among those: he offered to pay me 400 USD a month, every month, to make a custom Wordpress theme for him. I took him up on it. His offer really helped. The ability to hammer out a Wordpress theme and cover my living

entries.title: Tell HN: Please continue offering your services (goods, rooms etc)
entries.author: jacquesm
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Please continue offering your services (goods, rooms etc)
entries.excerpt: I've read and taken in swombats post to 'stop offering your services', and I think that he may have a point in the general sense, that some may abuse this format to gain a business advantage. That said, I think it is much too early to make the call to stop doing this, let's fix problems if and when they appear. entries.title: Tell HN: Please stop offering your services
entries.author: swombat
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Please stop offering your services
entries.excerpt: This is not a sustainable model. There are thousands of HN users, each with their own areas of expertise. Often, a good test of whether something is worth doing is "what if everyone did the same?" If everyone was more polite, the world would be a better place. If everyone treated others better, the world would be a better place. entries.title: Founders who can't code
entries.author: rokhayakebe
entries.excerpt: An advise to founders who can't code If you are a business/idea guy and looking for a technical co founder, stop. Stop right now. Take 6 months off and go learn how to code (day and night, weekends including). Most web apps do little besides save, show and update data. No, You will NOT become an engineer, programmer, or web developer, but you will be able to put a prototype of your idea together and maybe get one or two beta users for feedback. entries.guide_zh: 作者建议不懂技术的创始人先花半年学编程，再考虑寻找技术合伙人。

entries.title: Ask HN: Tools of the trade, 2010 edition
entries.author: joshu
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Tools of the trade, 2010 edition
entries.excerpt: When I first started delicious, we had to host most of the services ourselves. CVS, mail, mailing lists, etc etc etc. These days, lots of that stuff is available as SaaS. What are the tools and services people use instead of hosting their own? (I'm not talking about actual production services like EC2 and Heroku and whatnot. We can go over this in another thread.)
entries.guide_zh: 从自行维护服务器到使用 SaaS，2010 年创业团队都在用哪些工具？
